Faq.subtitleLead: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out on
Faq.subtitleTail: or use the contact section below.

trial.question: How do I book a bike or scooter?
trial.answer: Use the booking form at the top of this page to choose pick-up location, vehicle type, and pick-up date. You can also message us on WhatsApp and we will walk you through availability and the best option for your trip.

plan.question: What licence do I need for 50cc vs 125cc?
plan.answer: Requirements depend on your licence and local rules. Tell us what licence you hold when you book and we will confirm which categories you can ride. We prioritise safety and compliance on every rental.

cancel.question: What is your cancellation policy?
cancel.answer: Cancellations made more than 48 hours before the scheduled rental start time are eligible for a 50% refund of the booking amount. Explore Malta Rentals retains the remaining 50%. Cancellations made within 48 hours of the scheduled rental start time are non-refundable, and the full booking amount is retained.

invoice.question: Are helmets and safety gear included?
invoice.answer: Yes — helmets are included with rentals, along with a phone holder accessory for navigation. If you need a specific helmet size or have other safety questions, tell us when you book so we can have everything ready at handover.

billing.question: How does pricing and billing work?
billing.answer: Rates are based on your rental period and vehicle category. You will see what applies before you confirm. For exact quotes or longer hires, WhatsApp us with your dates.

email.question: Can I return the bike somewhere other than Pietà?
email.answer: It depends on the vehicle and dates. Message us on WhatsApp with your plans and we will confirm whether return elsewhere or hotel delivery is possible.

support.question: How does support work for tourists?
support.answer: We are set up for visitors: clear handover instructions, practical tips for riding in Malta, and quick help on WhatsApp if something comes up during your rental.

tutorials.question: Do you offer guided tours?
tutorials.answer: Yes. We offer rentals plus guided tours so you can explore Malta with support if you prefer not to go alone. Ask when you book and we will share what is running during your stay.

projects.question: Can I extend my rental once I am in Malta?
projects.answer: Often yes, subject to availability. Message us before your return time and we will do our best to extend your booking.

team.question: Do I need to leave a deposit?
team.answer: Deposit and ID requirements are explained at booking confirmation. If you are unsure, send us a WhatsApp message and we will outline exactly what is needed for your chosen vehicle.

About.narrativeP1: {companyName}, your go-to choice to experience Malta your way. From affordable self-drive motorbike rental, quadbike hire and bicycles, to a guided tour around Malta.
About.narrativeP2: We are passionate about helping locals and visitors experience the beauty of Malta in the most free, flexible, and affordable way possible.

lifecycle.title: Booking process
lifecycle.genericError: Unable to complete this action. Please try again.
lifecycle.readOnlyCompleted: This booking is completed. No further lifecycle actions are available.
lifecycle.readOnlyCancelled: This booking was cancelled. Restore it if it was cancelled by mistake.

PENDING_PAYMENT.title: Awaiting payment — soft reservation
PENDING_PAYMENT.description: The customer started checkout but Stripe has not confirmed payment yet. The vehicle is temporarily held for the checkout window. If payment is not completed, this booking is cancelled automatically and the vehicle is released.
PENDING_PAYMENT.nextStep: Wait for payment to succeed, or cancel this booking to release the unit immediately.

CONFIRMED.title: Confirmed: reservation active
CONFIRMED.description: The booking is accepted and a physical unit is reserved. For online payments, money has already been confirmed by Stripe. Security deposit may still be collected at pickup depending on the customer's choice.
CONFIRMED.nextStep: When the customer arrives for pickup or the vehicle is delivered, record the handover. If they want a different model before handover, change the booked vehicle. If the booking will not go ahead, cancel it to release the unit.

VEHICLE_HANDED_OVER.title: Vehicle handed over — rental in progress
VEHICLE_HANDED_OVER.description: The customer has the vehicle. Payment and deposit should be recorded as collected if received at handover. The assigned unit is marked out with the customer.
VEHICLE_HANDED_OVER.nextStep: When the customer returns the vehicle, mark it returned. Do not refund the deposit at this stage — inspection may still be needed.

RETURNED.title: Vehicle returned — awaiting closure
RETURNED.description: The vehicle is back. The unit may be available or sent to maintenance depending on what you recorded at return. The security deposit is not settled yet.
RETURNED.nextStep: After inspecting the vehicle and settling the deposit (refund or deduction), complete the booking to close it out.

COMPLETED.title: Completed — booking closed
COMPLETED.description: This rental is fully closed. Payment, deposit, and vehicle unit status have been finalised. No further lifecycle changes are needed.

CANCELLED.title: Cancelled — booking voided
CANCELLED.description: This booking was cancelled. The assigned unit was released for future bookings. Payment and deposit statuses reflect what was recorded at cancellation.
CANCELLED.nextStep: If this was cancelled by mistake, restore it to put the reservation back on the calendar. If a cancellation email was already sent, contact the customer.

handOver.summary: Record that the customer collected or received the vehicle.
handOver.effects: Sets booking to Vehicle Handed Over. Marks payment as paid and deposit as collected when confirmed. Unit becomes Out with customer.

markReturned.summary: Record that the vehicle has been returned by the customer.
markReturned.effects: Sets booking to Returned. Unit becomes Available or Maintenance based on condition. Deposit is not refunded automatically.

complete.summary: Close the booking after return inspection and deposit handling.
complete.effects: Sets booking to Completed. Deposit is marked Refunded or Deducted. Unit status is finalised for fleet use.

cancel.summary: Cancel a confirmed booking that will not proceed.
cancel.effects: Sets booking to Cancelled and releases the reserved unit back to Available. Payment stays Pending unless already paid/refunded.

restore.summary: Undo a cancellation and put the reservation back on the calendar.
restore.effects: Restores the previous booking status and reserves the original vehicle unit for the original dates. Payment status is left unchanged.

extend.summary: Keep the same vehicle for a later return time.
extend.effects: Moves the return time later when that unit is free. Extra days use this booking's original daily rate. Delivery, storage, and the deposit are unchanged.

changeVehicle.summary: Change the booked bike model before the customer takes the vehicle.
changeVehicle.effects: Keeps this booking, the customer, and the dates. The replacement model must be free for the whole rental. A reserved unit is released and a unit of the new model is reserved. The agreed price stays unless you apply the new model's rate. Card payments are not charged or refunded.

replaceVehicle.summary: Replace the physical bike the customer is already using.
replaceVehicle.effects: Keeps this booking, the dates, and the agreed price. The previous bike stays in the vehicle history and leaves Out with customer. The replacement is handed over for the rest of the rental. Card payments are not charged or refunded.
